overall_assessment: HVL extraction is largely accurate: headings map cleanly to the seven sections, learning outcomes keep all sub-groups, and arbeidskrav land in coursework_requirements rather than assessment. Remaining issues are minor: logistics/cost text in teaching_methods, a practice-description block filed as coursework, and placeholder values. Most pre-pass flags (empty prerequisites/coursework, leak->reading_list) are false alarms.

findings.evidence:
PRAKSIS 3. STUDIEÅR
Ledelse av barn og barnehagen.
findings.description: A long descriptive block about the practice period (aims, what the student should develop, lederdager) sits under an uppercase 'OBLIGATORISK LÆRINGSAKTIVITET' sub-heading and is filed wholesale as coursework_requirements (2297 chars). Only the final part (godkjent/ikke godkjent activities, 80% attendance) is a pass/approve gate; the practice description is course content / teaching.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The sub-heading 'OBLIGATORISK LÆRINGSAKTIVITET' and the following 'PRAKSIS 3. STUDIEÅR' text are not split; the heading map has no pattern for 'Praksis ...' sub-headings so the text stays with the previous coursework block.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a pattern for 'PRAKSIS ... STUDIEÅR' headings in R/section_heading_map.R (map to course_content or teaching_methods), so it ends the coursework block.

findings.evidence: Kr 400 i materialpenger betales inn ved studiestart (150 for naturfag, 150 for fysisk fostring og 100 for mat & helse).
findings.description: teaching_methods absorbs logistics under the 'Undervisnings- og læringsformer' heading: material fees, excursion prices, exam dates and admission statements (e.g. 'Eksamen blir avholdt i starten av Januar', 'Dette emnet er opptakskrav på ingeniørutdanninga'). These are not teaching methods.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The whole block under the heading is taken verbatim; sub-paragraphs such as 'Forflyttet undervisning' and unlabelled logistics paragraphs are not filtered by .clean_sections().
findings.suggested_fix: Add HVL-specific drop rules in .clean_sections()/.drop for lines on 'Kr \d+', 'materialpenger', 'egenandel', 'Eksamen blir avholdt' and 'opptakskrav på'.

findings.evidence: Tid og sted for eksamen blir opplyst på Studentweb.
findings.description: Exam logistics (time and place announced on Studentweb / learning platform) remain in assessment, against the rubric that exam logistics should not be in assessment.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: No cleaning rule for 'Tid og sted for eksamen ...' / 'Tid for ut- og innlevering ...' sentences.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop lines matching 'Tid (og sted )?for (eksamen|ut- og innlevering)' and 'opplyst på (Studentweb|emnets sider)' in assessment cleaning.

findings.description: Generic admission statement ('Studiets opptakskrav.') kept as prerequisite text next to a real recommended course; it is not a course prerequisite.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Both 'Krav til forkunnskaper' and 'Anbefalte forkunnskaper' are concatenated without an admission-boilerplate filter.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop prerequisites lines equal to 'Studiets opptakskrav' / 'Opptakskrav' (also 'Studierett på Master ...' type lines if the spec treats them as admission).

findings.evidence: Ja, vert spesifisert i semesterplan ved semesterstart
findings.description: Placeholder-like values are emitted as rows: prerequisites '_' (1 char), coursework_requirements 'Ja' (2 chars) or 'Ja, vert spesifisert i semesterplan ved semesterstart', and DAT300 course_content that is only a link ('Emnebeskrivelse, se http://www.uib.no/en/course/INF399'). They carry no real content. Note 'Ingen' is already dropped correctly.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The placeholder filter handles 'Ingen' but not '_' or bare 'Ja'; a pointer to another institution's plan is not recognised.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat '_', '-' and bare 'Ja'/'Nei' as empty in the placeholder filter (keep the longer 'Ja, vert spesifisert' variant as a short requirement or flag it); consider treating 'se http...' pointer-only content as empty.
